content.text:
**Point: `benchmark` — Comparison index (real assets policy blend) Q3 2026 return 3.4%**

**Verdict: not_conveyed**

The letter reports the sleeve's own performance figures in full — 2.9% net and 3.1% gross for Q3, 6.1% year to date, and 8.7% trailing 12 months — but never introduces the comparison index. There is no mention of the real assets policy blend, its composition (40% global listed infrastructure / 30% global REITs / 20% US TIPS / 10% broad commodities), or its 3.4% Q3 return. Nor is there any indirect signal of relative performance, such as a statement that the sleeve trailed or outpaced its benchmark.

This is a straightforward omission rather than a distortion: nothing in the letter contradicts the 3.4% figure, it simply is not there. Worth flagging, though, that the omission removes the only context showing the sleeve underperformed its policy blend by 50 basis points net (2.9% vs. 3.4%), so the performance paragraph reads more favorably than the fact sheet supports.

points.evidence: The letter's performance paragraph states only sleeve returns: "a return of 2.9% net of fees (3.1% gross of fees)... year to date through September 30, 2026, the return was 6.1% net of fees... trailing 12 months... 8.7% net of fees." No comparison index, policy blend composition, or 3.4% figure appears anywhere in the letter, and there is no relative-performance language substituting for it.
